messages:
incident_bot: Incident created: high memory growth on paged-attention allocator (kv-cache) — potential slow leak -> OOM across 3 nodes in eu-west-1. Severity: P1 :rotating_light:
elaine_r: seeing repeated OOMs on serving-runtime-3/4/7, containers restarting every ~12-18m. stack traces show paged allocator churn.
mike_oncall: yup, hit this during load test earlier but didn't go full OOM. difference now is a sustained 95th token rate hump.
jordan_infra: observed CUDA errors on node 7 just before restart: `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` then `OOM when allocating tensor` in attention pager. logs: ```ERROR serving::runtime: attention pager failed: illegal address while copying page; allocator: paged-kv, attempted 1.2GB alloc```
sam_k: are we sure it's fragmentation and not a real leak from model change? last deploy was 3491205000 (quant profile tweak).
elaine_r: good call — but telemetry shows same leak pattern on nodes with older model variants. points to allocator fragmentation.
mike_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) throttle or disable attention paging on affected pool, 2) bump eviction aggressiveness for kv-cache, 3) roll nodes to clear fragments, 4) scale up to short-term spare capacity to avoid customer impact.
jordan_infra: starting a pool-wide canary to disable paging: `redwoodctl runtime set-param --pool serving-eu-west --param attention_paging.enabled=false --ttl 30m`
deploy_bot: Rollout started: attention_paging toggle -> serving-eu-west. 5 of 20 instances updated.
anya_cs: getting early slack from customers — a few request timeouts from enterprise tier, flagged support ticket INC-8342. I'll draft a customer note.
elsa: (reaction :eyes:)
elaine_r: after toggling, node restarts decreased but memory still trending. we need eviction tweak too. Trying `kv.eviction.target_fill=0.6` on the pool.
jordan_infra: applied eviction target fill to 0.6 on pool. watch for perf impact — could increase token cost.
mike_oncall: commanded a graceful restart on the three worst nodes: `kubectl rollout restart ds/serving-runtime -l node=eu-west-7` to force slab compaction.
sam_k: logs post-restart show fewer cuda illegal-addresss but intermittent "paged-fragmentation: free-scan skipped heavy-fragmentation" warnings.
elaine_r: adding temporary allocation guard to avoid runaway prefetch: `REDWOOD_PAGED_PREFETCH=0` on runtime envs. Jordan, can we hotpatch minimal changes without full deploy?
jordan_infra: hotpatch env var via `redwoodctl nodes patch --pool serving-eu-west --env REDWOOD_PAGED_PREFETCH=0`. doing it now.
deploy_bot: Env patch applied to 20 nodes (rolling).
mike_oncall: telemetry: after both toggles (paging off + prefetch off + eviction bump) memory slope flattened on 14/20 nodes. three nodes still creeping — those are the ones with older kernel driver (470.x). suspect kernel-level fragmentation interaction.
jordan_infra: flagged to infra: will cordon + reprovision nodes with 510.x driver. scheduling drain of 3 nodes now.
anya_cs: customer-impact update: enterprise customer A experienced 503s for ~7 minutes during the initial flares, now recovered. sent initial heads-up, will follow up with RCA once stable.
elaine_r: we're seeing one reproducible stack: `allocator->paged::compact_scan()` gets stuck because of many small resident pages; compaction fails and free list grows. adding a runtime metric alert for `paged.compaction.failures>5` to catch earlier.
mike_oncall: can we temporarily enable fallback to smaller-kv (non-paged) variant for high-risk customers? we have model-compatible non-paged variants for some.
jordan_infra: routing policy updated: high-priority routes -> non-paged variant if node has had >2 restarts in 30m. applied.
sam_k: I pushed a small patch to allocator: better free-run consolidation on free lists; will run through canary tomorrow. won't be patched in prod during incident.
elaine_r: status update: memory creep arrested on 18 nodes, 2 nodes reprovision queued, 1 node showing intermittent fragmentation but currently stable. mitigation state: mitigated, not resolved.
mike_oncall: handoff plan: I'll remain on-call for next 2h to watch telemetry and coordinate infra reprovs. Elaine, if you need escalation to eng-runtime, ping @sam_k and @jordan_infra.
anya_cs: updated customer note: "We've applied temporary mitigations to reduce memory pressure and routed traffic to compatible model variants where necessary. We will provide a post-incident summary within 24 hours."
incident_bot: Incident severity lowered to P2 — mitigations active, no active user-impact for >10m.
elaine_r: adding runbook notes to incident page: steps taken, commands used, affected node IDs, metrics charts. I'll also attach kernel driver versions and node reprovision timestamps.
mike_oncall: final checklist before handoff: 1) ensure cordoned nodes reprovisioned 2) eviction target reverted to baseline after 2h of stability 3) scheduled allocator patch review 4) customer comms posted.
jordan_infra: reprovision jobs queued; ETA ~35m.
elaine_r: handing off to Mike for watch. I'll be available on slack but switching to support rotation.
mike_oncall: acknowledged — taking handoff. If any node crosses `paged.compaction.failures>3` alert, page me and escalate to eng-runtime.
deploy_bot: Rollout completed: attention_paging toggle removed from 20 nodes (state=disabled).
incident_bot: Incident closed (mitigated -> monitoring). Root cause pending deeper allocator analysis.
anya_cs: creating follow-up ticket for customer-facing RCA and linking this thread. thanks team. :heart:
